items.title: Tone of the news, 1945-2010
items.notes: Source-recovery-only diagnostic: Supplemental Graphics reference and Leetaru/GDELT source visuals recovered; original month-level NYT/SWB tone data were not recovered, and no Pinker plotted values were digitized.

items.title: Life expectancy, 1771-2015
items.notes: Book-period reconstruction is verified. The extended artifact intentionally plots no successor segment because a comparable regional successor series has not been accepted.

items.title: Child mortality, 1751-2013
items.notes: Remediated to use the current OWID selected child-mortality grapher directly in percent units. This materially improves the visual match, but the exact Roser 2016a UN/HMD vintage remains unrecovered.

items.title: Undernourishment, 1970-2015
items.notes: Fresh review found that the prior reconstruction substituted broad Africa/Asia/World curves for several book regional curves. The remediation replaces those with current FAO successor regional entities where available, but the exact Roser 2016j/FAO 2014 regional vintage and 1991-1999 regional segments remain unrecovered.

items.title: Famine deaths, 1860-2016
items.notes: The previous reconstruction recomputed rates from an event table with a current population denominator. Remediation uses OWID's explicit decadal famine-death-rate grapher series, which fixes the aggregation treatment, but it is a 2025 World Peace Foundation/OWID successor rather than the archived 2017 Hasell-Roser book vintage.

items.title: Gross World Product, 1-2015
items.notes: The successor OWID/Maddison/World Bank series preserves the hockey-stick shape and book-period coverage, but the 2015 scale is materially above the printed figure's apparent endpoint, so this is an updated equivalent rather than an exact reproduction.

items.title: GDP per capita, 1600-2015
items.notes: The selected countries and line ordering broadly match the book, but current Maddison 2020/OWID data are not the cited Maddison Project 2014/World Bank 2016 vintage. Remaining differences are not typography-only.

items.title: World income distribution, 1800, 1975, and 2015
items.notes: Production loop 2026-07-01. Updated-equivalent Gapminder Income Mountains v2 reconstruction; exact book-era mountain snapshot remains unrecovered.

items.title: Extreme poverty (proportion), 1820-2015
items.notes: Book-period reconstruction is verified. The comparison layout was remediated so the recreated plot area is comparable to the Kindle crop; no comparable world extension is plotted.

items.title: Extreme poverty (number), 1820-2015
items.notes: A falsification audit found no material source, encoding, or endpoint issue. The reconstruction uses the cited OWID historical absolute-count series and matches the stacked-area visual claim; remaining differences are production styling only.

items.title: Social spending, OECD countries, 1880-2016
items.notes: For verification, recover the exact OWID Ortiz-Ospina & Roser 2016b/2017 chart data snapshot; otherwise keep updated_equivalent status.

items.title: Poverty, US, 1960-2016
items.notes: Production loop 2026-07-01. Verified from Meyer & Sullivan 2017 Table 1; dotted extension is the report's 2017 point.

items.title: Population and population growth, 1750-2015 and projected to 2100
items.notes: Production loop 2026-07-01. Updated-equivalent current OWID/UN successor reconstruction; exact 2016 OWID/HYDE/IIASA source vintage remains unrecovered.

items.title: Oil spills, 1970-2016
items.notes: Current repository state: oil-spill line supported; exact annual oil-shipping gray-line source unresolved. See figures/10-5/.

items.title: Protected areas, 1990-2014
items.notes: Current repository state: archived WDI 2017 source verifies book-period reconstruction; extension is successor current WDI series. See figures/10-6/.

items.title: Carbon intensity (CO2 emissions per dollar of GDP), 1820-2014
items.notes: Book-period source and visual geometry closely match. Extension is useful but explicitly successor-series only.

items.title: CO2 emissions, 1960-2015
items.notes: Book-period stack uses the exact OWID 2017 regional CDIAC dataset named by the source chain. Extension is visually separated by a 2015 boundary because source definitions changed.

items.title: Plane crash deaths, 1970-2015
items.notes: Track D 2026-06-30: source-family reconstruction generated from OWID-hosted ASN 2019 successor data and World Bank passengers; early-1970s visual peak under-matches.

items.title: Natural disaster deaths, 1900-2015
items.notes: Track D 2026-06-30: OWID datasets repo EM-DAT death-rate reconstruction generated; current OWID successor extension added.

items.title: Lightning strike deaths, US, 1900-2015
items.notes: Track D 2026-06-30: OWID NOAA/Lopez-Holle fatality-rate dataset visually reproduces Kindle chart; no comparable post-2015 rate extension recovered.

items.title: Nuclear weapons, 1945-2015
items.notes: Actual Kindle chart-page capture is now present. The reconstruction remains partial because it uses a current OWID successor line series rather than the cited HumanProgress/FAS 2016 table and does not reproduce the book's stacked-area presentation.
